items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: My first job I played out, I remember, with the old man Tom Albert.

ctx.x: Norm? Norm, yeah. That's why I was wondering if that was the same man he mentioned. Well, that's it. What did you play your first job with?
My first job, speaking about job, playing out. My first job I played out, I remember, with the old man Tom Albert.
When would that have been about?

items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: I was the first one they played a job with. Fest with.

ctx.x: Yeah, I was playing violin. Yeah, playing violin.

Yeah, playing violin. Yeah. He didn't even tie it, but I never did. He used to come over there and play it when I was young, you understand? Mm-hm. Used to be around first. Well I was the first one taking him and Peeta on the job. He used to come over there and play when I was young, you understand? Used to be around the fest. Well I was the first one taking him and Peter on the job. Oh yeah? Fest. They was learning and I'd take them down the breakway in the cane cart. After grinding. I was the first one they…
Who else did you have in that band?

items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Just giving a little dance down there for the people. And the Fess, and, uh, I believe I carried a

ctx.x: What do you call it, the cane cart?

Yeah, the whole cane in it. Yeah, yeah. And they come to get us, uh, the carnet down there, we finished grinding, you know. Just giving a little dance down there for the people. And the Fess, and, uh, I believe I carried a, uh, uh, uh, um, that fella insurance man, there, his cousin.
Oh, uh, Humphrey, uh... Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
